programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The true story of WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange and his epic struggle against the US government over classified intelligence documents that were exposed for public scrutiny.

programme.title: Road to Perdition
programme.desc: A betrayed mob hit man goes the lam with his son, and seeks revenge against vicious gangsters. As the bullets start to fly, the impressionable child is exposed to the goriest aspects of his father's talents in this gorgeously stylized action thriller.

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: Val Kilmer portrays Leslie Charteris's fictional spy Simon Templar, who's hired by the Russians to steal a U.S. physicist's formula.

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: The story of two criminals with different ambitions, set to music. Two small-time criminals, Mike and Troy, are looking for that one big score and think they've found it. Meeting at a secluded cafe for the handover, they wait as danger moves ever closer. While waiting, Troy falls for the waitress, Gloria, and begins to question his life choices. But it may be too late for him to change his future before it comes to an abrupt end.

programme.title: Billionaire Boys Club
programme.desc: In early 1980's Los Angeles, rich boys led by Joe Hunt hit it big with a Ponzi scheme. Things go horribly wrong for all involved when they learn they've been betrayed by their investor, high roller Ron Levin, leaving Hunt owing a lot of money to a lot of people.

programme.title: First Shift
programme.desc: A rookie cop faces unexpected challenges and dangers during her first night on the job. She must navigate a series of intense situations to prove herself.

programme.title: Irena's Vow
programme.desc: This period film is set during the German occupation of Poland in the 1940s. Based on true accounts, the drama follows Irene Gut Opdyke, a nineteen-year-old hotel kitchen worker hired by Rugmer, a Nazi official. She was later promoted as a housekeeper to serve in Rugmer's home, where, unbeknownst to him, she also managed to shelter twelve Jews in the cellar.

programme.title: Searching for Bobby Fischer
programme.desc: Moving story about the relationship between a chess prodigy (Max Pomeranc) and his overbearing father (Joe Mantegna).

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: Val Kilmer portrays Leslie Charteris's fictional spy Simon Templar, who's hired by the Russians to steal a U.S. physicist's formula.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: A sharpshooting FBI agent goes undercover as a surfer to stop a crime wave.

programme.title: The Crossing Guard
programme.desc: A tale about a jeweler who's obsessed with taking revenge on the man convicted of killing his daughter.

programme.title: Chinatown
programme.desc: Screenwriter Robert Towne won an Oscar for this film about murder and corruption in 1930s Los Angeles, directed by Roman Polanski.

programme.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
programme.desc: Based on the actual death of elderly African American ex-serviceman Kenneth Chamberlain Sr. whom a team of police officers killed during a welfare check on him. This drama unpacks the lead-up to the event and the truth about the conflict.

programme.title: Fear the Night
programme.desc: Tes, a former Iraqi war veteran, is called back to action when a group of invaders decides to crash her sister's bachelorette party. She quickly realizes that these people are going to leave no one behind, and she must fight to stay alive. With the safety of an entire party resting on her shoulders, Tes can't afford to make any mistakes.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: A sharpshooting FBI agent goes undercover as a surfer to stop a crime wave.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: A cop in 2019 America is framed for massacring rioting civilians during a famine. After escaping from jail he tries to prove his innocence, but is captured along with an innocent civilian, and they are forced to participate in a violent game show called "The Running Man".

programme.title: SNAG
programme.desc: An Australian lone wolf's quiet existence is shattered when he learns that the woman he once loved and thought was dead is alive and held captive by ruthless gangsters. Now, to take on this dangerous criminal organization, he must seek out allies and storm into a world of violence to rescue the love of his life in this gritty, modern day violent fairy tale.

programme.title: How She Move
programme.desc: An aspiring medical student enters a step-dancing competition in hopes of securing the funds needed to continue her education at the private school where she has been studying.

programme.title: Death Without Mercy
programme.desc: Documentary following two Syrian families over the course of ten days in the wake of the 7.8 magnitude earthquake in 2023 that left 50,000 people dead in Southern Turkey. Featuring CCTV footage from above ground, first-person footage from under the rubble, extensive vérité footage (some recorded on cell phones), drone footage, and news and archival footage, the tragedy is pieced together, uncovering the corruption, lies and government incompetence that exacerbated the disaster and its response.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: A man teams up with his smooth-talking friend in the wake of a major breakup. Hitting the hotspots in Las Vegas and Los Angeles, the duo meet up with friends and prowl for sex and cheap thrills.

programme.title: The Wood
programme.desc: Three black friends gather for a wedding, and recall their teen years growing up in 1980s Inglewood, Cal., after the groom gets cold feet and starts thinking about his high-school sweetheart. A touching and nostalgic coming-of-age tale.

programme.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
programme.desc: Wildly inept Los Angeles cop Frank Drebin tries to foil an assassination. Inspired by the 1982 TV series.

programme.title: Road Trip
programme.desc: Tom Green's film debut casts him as a perpetual college student narrating the raucous odyssey of four university buddies as they make their way from Ithaca, N.Y., to Austin. Their goal: retrieve an illicit video, which was mailed by mistake. Breckin Meyer, Seann William Scott, Amy Smart, Paulo Costanzo, DJ Qualls, Rachel Blanchard.

programme.title: Last Vegas
programme.desc: Four geriatric friends head to Las Vegas for a bucks' night that recaptures the magic of their glory days. But Vegas has changed since the last time they prowled the Strip, and once the party gets started, there's no telling how it will end.

programme.title: The Fabulous Four
programme.desc: Three lifelong female friends, a tight-knit group who have preserved their friendship for decades since their college years, embark on a trip to Florida with a specific reason to become bridesmaids. Never mind that they are all over sixty years of age. They are attending their college friend's surprise wedding. However, as they spend time rekindling friendship moments and memories, other issues also emerge.

programme.title: The End of Sex
programme.desc: Emma and Josh have been struggling with their adult issues coupled with their parenting issues. They decide to take matters into their own hands to preserve their union. Thus, they ship their kids off to attend a sleepaway camp so they can have their alone time. They then begin experimenting with various sexual adventures, often comical, to reignite that spark again.

programme.title: Top Five

programme.title: Together Together
programme.desc: A neurotic single father hires a woman to be the surrogate for his future baby. Cue a unique bond that will both bring them together and pull them apart as he begins to pry a little too deeply into the personal life of his surrogate in this comedy film.

programme.title: Treasure
programme.desc: An American journalist decides to travel back to Poland with her Holocaust-surviving father. The goal of their trip was to revisit some of his favorite childhood locations. But an internal resistance to his past trauma proved to be more difficult than originally thought.

programme.title: 6 Days
programme.desc: In this docudrama about the 1980 Iranian Embassy siege in London, a police negotiator tries to prevent six gunmen from harming 26 hostages. Meanwhile, SAS teams prepare for a rescue operation.

programme.title: Mass

programme.title: Happy Gilmore
programme.desc: All Happy Gilmore (Adam Sandler) has ever wanted is to be a professional hockey player. But he soon discovers he may actually have a talent for playing an entirely different sport: golf. When his grandmother (Frances Bay) learns she is about to lose her home, Happy joins a golf tournament to try and win enough money to buy it for her. With his powerful driving skills and foulmouthed attitude, Happy becomes an unlikely golf hero -- much to the chagrin of the well-mannered golf professionals.

Life is good at the small town restaurant until two corporate execs bring news that Deeds is about to be rolling in a different kind of dough. A long-lost relative has left him an inheritance of 40 billion dollars along with the largest media company in the world. It's a fish out of water, rags to riches story that has local tabloid reporters salivating.

programme.title: Billy Madison

When his father, hotel magnate Brian, becomes fed up with his son's irresponsible ways, he issues an ultimatum. Since Billy passed all his schooling thanks to his father's influence and bribes, he must retake and pass every grade in 24 weeks. Otherwise, the business will be turned over to Brian's conniving associate, Eric.

programme.title: The Jerk
programme.desc: Navin (Steve Martin) believes he was born a poor black child in Mississippi. He is, however, actually white. Upon figuring this out, he heads north to St. Louis to find himself. After landing a job at a gas station, Navin is excited to discover his name printed in the new phone book. This ratification of his existence leads him from one misadventure to another -- as he invents gadgets, dodges bullets, joins the carnival and seeks love in the arms of beautiful Marie (Bernadette Peters).
